Do not unmortgage Baltic/VT/CT/SL ($33/$55/$66/$110) — no monopoly, tiny rent, cash $472 is the red-rent buffer. Do not trade orange/pink/GOOJF or give p2 cash. p4 has $16 and cannot build. message.reasoning:
I need to make a decision in Monopoly.

I have $472 and am on CHANCE. My pink and orange properties are fully built with two and four houses respectively. I hold one GOOJF card. Other players are in various states: p2 has $345 and is on PENNSYLVANIA_RAILROAD, p3 is bankrupt, and p4 has only $16 after paying rent.

The bank has no houses left but still 12 hotels. NORTH_CAROLINA_AVENUE is unowned. I just built one house on ST_JAMES_PLACE, ST_CHARLES_PLACE, and STATES_AVENUE.

I emptied the bank of houses. Hotels would return four houses to the bank, which p2 could then buy, so I will not build hotels. I can unmortgage my four properties for $264 total.

Unmortgaging would not give me a monopoly. I will not trade away houses or monopolies. I will not sell buildings. I will keep my housing lock.

A trade for Boardwalk and Park Place would require too much cash and risk breaking the housing lock. Four houses on the orange properties generate $750–$800 in rent each, making the current setup extremely profitable.

I checked the exact rent table. Virginia with two houses pays $220. The orange properties pay $250–$300 with two houses.

I realized my earlier rent estimates for the orange properties were wrong. Standard Monopoly values place St. James at $700 with three houses and $875 with four, not $550 or $750. The previous $550 rent p4 paid on St. James confirms it had three houses before this turn's build.

Hoteling one property would return four houses to the bank. p2 could buy two of them with $300, completing their red set and making it lethal. p4 has only $16 and cannot purchase houses. I will not hotel.

Unmortgaging my properties would cost $264 total. The resulting low rents offer no strategic value. My $472 cash buffer is sufficient to absorb p2's red rent if I land on those spaces.

I estimate p2's red properties pay roughly $700–$1,025 in rent. My $472 cash buffer is enough to survive a Marvin hit, so I do not need to unmortgage my properties. I am also considering whether to buy Park Place from p4, who holds it mortgaged.

I rejected the trade for Boardwalk and Park Place. It would require selling orange houses to build dark blue, destroying the housing lock. I cannot force p4 to mortgage yellow properties or pay cash to p2. I will end my turn.
